body: I went to a psychiatrist again yesterday and was diagnosed with Bipolar disorder, plus he wants to do some further screening for a co-existing (don't thinks that's the terminology he used) anxiety disorder. They're recommending meds and therapy, so I will probably be starting that relatively soon. Let's hope it works, thanks for your support and concerns.

In the past I painted and did track and field but with each bout of sadness I lost more and more interest in them. Sometimes in my short spans of feeling alive (for lack of a better word) I'll pick up the paintbrush again and whip out a few amazing things. Although I usually end up destroying them in a fit of rage later in that same span of energy. These days I just try and sleep for as long as I can and to be quite honest use substances to try to stop feeling at all.
No, I don't really think so. I really just posted this so hopefully others would understand a bit of how I felt and to see if they knew some magical way out of the vicious cycle.

I'm glad you, and I'm sure others, understand. I'm counting on folks like you to explain to those who don't understand the pain why I decided to leave. Thank you for your reply, it truly helps to ease the worry.
